description: Principles of amplitude, frequency and phase modulation. Design of communication systems using link budget. Modulators, mixers and demodulators. Elementary digital communications, PSK, and FSK. System analysis using Matlab. Random processes, power spectral density, noise in communication systems and matched filters.
